driver: The decisive quantity is the part of each candidate's measured gain that would not have arrived anyway inside the window the decision is judged over: a candidate that wins by bringing forward outcomes its units were already on course to produce through another route shows the largest gain at the moment of measurement and keeps little of it across the window, which is found only by following each unit's later outcomes or splitting the gains by whether the unit had already marked the item it took, while every closed case reproduces on the instantaneous measure because no closed candidate surfaced items its units had marked, so the leader on the instantaneous basis falls behind the candidate fourth on the natural estimate.
driver_concrete: The velocity-boost policy (B) pins two fast-selling listings in the buyer's sizes to tiles 1 and 2, and most of them are already on that buyer's watch list, so B's in-session orders are largely purchases the favourites tab and price-drop alerts would have delivered within days; the session-weighted estimator that reproduces all nine archived carousel tests scores in-session orders, which every archived test reproduces because no archived policy surfaced watched listings, so only following each buyer's orders after the session, or splitting B's orders by watch-list status against what watched listings convert to without a carousel push, shows that B keeps a fraction of its lift over the twelve-week slot, and the sequence ranker with a fresh-listing interleave (E), whose listings are too new to be on anyone's watch list, is the largest lift that clears the lift, eight-cell guardrail and fresh-listing conditions.
stump: A competent solver scores all six registered policies with the session-weighted estimator that alone reproduces the nine archived carousel tests, reads every guardrail at the charter's eight platform-by-tenure cells, checks the fresh-listing floor and commits the Q1 2027 slot to B, the velocity-boost policy, as the largest lift that clears all three conditions; the step that lands it there is taking the render log's in-session orders as the policy's effect, when most of B's in-session orders are listings already on the buyer's watch list that the buyer buys within days anyway, so over the twelve-week test B keeps a fraction of its lift and E, fourth on the natural estimate, is the largest lift that clears every condition.
